description: This PHP file defines the LeavePeriodController class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. The controller extends an abstract Vue controller and uses a trait to access leave period-related services. Its main functionality is to prepare and set up a Vue component with leave period month and date data during pre-rendering.

classes.name: LeavePeriodController
classes.description: Controller class for managing leave period data in a Vue component, extending the AbstractVueController and using LeavePeriodServiceTrait.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares leave period month data and sets up the Vue component with this data before rendering.
